Geography & Landmarks: Centered around the 220-hectare Powai Lake (created 1891), the area boasts significant biodiversity, including migratory birds. Key, well-known, and popular landmarks include IIT Bombay, the National Institute of Industrial Engineering (NITIE) (now IIM Mumbai), and the Hiranandani Gardens.
Lifestyle & Culture: Known for its vibrant, cosmopolitan community, the area is packed with trendy cafes, upscale pubs like Madeira & Mime, and restaurants in Hiranandani. The Lakeside Promenade is a popular spot for walking, and Nirvana Park provides greenery.
Economy & Education: Beyond being a residential hotspot, it is a major commercial area hosting corporate parks, IT offices, and startups, earning it the nickname "Startup Valley".
Connectivity: It offers excellent connectivity to the Western Express Highway, Eastern Express Highway, and the JVLR, facilitating travel to Andheri and Ghatkopar railway stations.
